properties.Caption: CO2e Analysis (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The CO2e Analysis report provides detailed insight into you CO2e Emissions and how you are purchasing Carbon Credit.

properties.Caption: CO2e Decomposition Tree (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The CO2e Decomposition Tree report breaks down CO2e emission metrics into its key contributing components to help users understand what is driving changes in CO2 emissions and why.

properties.Caption: CO2e Key Influences (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The CO2e Key Influencers report identifies the key factors driving CO2e emission increases, highlighting the most impactful variables and trends based on the sustainability account categories.

name: Emissions by Cat and Scope PBI

properties.Caption: Emissions by Category and Scope (Power BI)
properties.AboutTitle: About Emissions by Category and Scope (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Emissions by Scope report breakdowns each emission type and showcases this based on the Account Category and the Scope so you can see how each account and scope is tracking.

properties.Caption: Realized Emissions vs. Baseline (Power BI)
properties.AboutTitle: About Realized Emissions vs. Baseline (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Realized Emissions by Bassline report breaks down your carbon emissions and allows for comparison against a defined baseline period. This allows you to track your progress against the baseline and monitor trends against a previous period.

properties.Caption: Sustainability Report (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Sustainability Report offers a view of all Sustainability report pages embedded into a single page for easy access.

name: To Net Zero Carbon Power BI

properties.Caption: Journey to Net Zero Carbon (Power BI)
properties.AboutTitle: About Journey to Net Zero Carbon (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Journey to Net Zero highlights the journey to net zero within an organization.

properties.Caption: Water and Waste Analysis (Power BI)
properties.AboutTitle: About Water and Waste Analysis (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Water and Waste Analysis allows you to effectively monitor your water and waste usage by different metrics such as Water Type, Intensity Type, and Responsibility Center.

properties.Caption: Billing Schedule (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Billing Schedule report provides a forecast of vendor and customer invoiced amounts according to the contractual billing rhythm. It helps to identify future development of incoming and outgoing cash from billed subscriptions.

properties.Caption: Churn Analysis (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Churn Analysis report breaks down churn by various dimensions such as contract term, contract type or product.

properties.Caption: Total Contract Value Analysis (Power BI)
properties.AboutTitle: About Total Contract Value Analysis (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Total Contract Value Analysis report breaks down Total Contract Value by various dimension such as billing rhythm, contract type or customer.

properties.Caption: Total Contract Value YoY (Power BI)
properties.AboutTitle: About Total Contract Value YoY (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Total Contract Value YoY report compares the Total Contract Value and Active Customers across a year-over-year period.

properties.Caption: Revenue by Salesperson (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Revenue by Salesperson report breaks down subscription performance by Salesperson, highlighting metrics such as Monthly Recurring Revenue, Monthly Recurring Cost, Monthly Net Profit Amount and Churn.

properties.Caption: Revenue Analysis (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Revenue Analysis report breaks down Monthly Recurring Revenue by various dimension such as billing rhythm, contract type or customer.

properties.Caption: Revenue by Customer (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Revenue by Customer report breaks down subscription performance by customer and item, highlighting metrics such as Monthly Recurring Revenue, Monthly Recurring Cost, Monthly Net Profit Amount and Monthly Net Profit %. This report provides detailed insights into which customers and items are driv...

properties.Caption: Revenue by Item (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Revenue by Item report breaks down subscription performance by item category, highlighting metrics such as Monthly Recurring Revenue, Monthly Recurring Cost, Monthly Net Profit Amount and Monthly Net Profit %. This report provides detailed insights into which categories and items are driving sub...

properties.Caption: Revenue Development (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Revenue Development report shows the change in monthly recurring revenue and helps to identify its various sources such as churn, downgrades, new subscriptions or upgrades.

properties.Caption: Revenue YoY (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Revenue YoY report compares Monthly Recurring Revenue performance across a year-over-year period.

properties.Caption: Sales and Cost forecast (Power BI)
properties.AboutTitle: About Sales and Cost forecast (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Sales and Cost forecast report provides the forecast of Monthly Recurring Revenue and Monthly Recurring Cost for the future months and years. This report provides detailed insights into which salespersons and customers are driving future subscription performance.

properties.Caption: Subscription Billing Report (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Subscription Billing Report offers a consolidated view of all subscription report pages, conveniently embedded into a single page for easy access.

properties.Caption: Subscription Overview (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Subscription Overview provides a comprehensive view of subscription performance, offering insights into metrics such as Monthly Recurring Revenue, Total Contract Value, Churn and top-performing customers or vendors.

properties.Caption: Vendor Deferrals (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Vendor Deferrals report provides an overview of deferred vs. released subscription cost amount.

properties.Caption: Customer Deferrals (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Customer Deferrals report provides an overview of deferred vs. released subscription sales amount.

controls.name: Enabled
controls.caption: Enabled
controls.tooltip: Specifies whether the AMC Banking 365 Fundamentals feature is enabled.

controls.name: User Name
controls.tooltip: Specifies the user name that represents your company's sign-up for the service that converts bank data to the format required by your bank when you export payment bank files and import bank statement files.

controls.name: Password
controls.caption: Password
controls.tooltip: Specifies your company's password to the service that converts bank data to the format required by your bank. The password that you enter in the Password field must be the same as on the service provider's sign-on page.

controls.name: Solution
controls.tooltip: Specifies a customizable calendar for bank's that holds the bank's working days and holidays. Choose the field to select another bank calendars or to set up a customized calendar.

controls.name: BCLicenseNumber
controls.caption: License
controls.tooltip: License number of Business Central for AMC Banking

controls.name: Service URL
controls.tooltip: Specifies the address of the service that converts bank data to the format required by your bank when you export payment bank files and import bank statement files. The service specified in the Service URL field is called when users export or import bank files.

controls.name: Namespace API Version
controls.tooltip: Specifies the default namespace for the AMC Banking.

actions.name: SignUp
actions.caption: Sign-up here
actions.tooltip: Calls the sign-up page for the service that converts bank data to the format required by your bank when you export payment bank files and import bank statement files. This is the web page where you enter your company's user name and password to sign up for the service.

actions.name: AMCAssistedSetup
actions.caption: Assisted Setup
actions.tooltip: Runs Service setup wizard

actions.name: BankList
actions.caption: Bank Name List
actions.tooltip: View or update the list of banks in your country/region that you can use to import or export bank account data using the AMC Banking.

actions.name: EncryptionManagement
actions.caption: Encryption Management
actions.tooltip: Enable or disable data encryption. Data encryption helps make sure that unauthorized users cannot read business data.

actions.name: ActivityLog
actions.caption: Activity Log
actions.tooltip: View AMC Banking 365 service activities.

actions.name: Support
actions.caption: Get support
actions.tooltip: Calls the web site where the provider of the AMC Banking publishes status and support information about the service.

properties.AboutText: Manage default settings for when and how inspections are created. Set up test generation rule triggers for production, inventory, and warehouse scenarios.
Control if new quality inspections should be created when similar inspections already exist.
Define how to select the quality inspections the system uses to decide whether a document transaction should be blocked for a lot or serial number.

actions.name: Templates
actions.caption: Inspection Templates
actions.tooltip: Quality inspection templates are inspection plans that contain a set of tests to perform.

actions.name: GenerationRules
actions.caption: Inspection Generation Rules
actions.tooltip: Quality inspection generation rules specify when quality inspections are automatically generated and which template is used, such as during receiving, production, or warehouse activities. You link a template to a source table and define filter criteria that determine when an inspection is created. W...

actions.name: Results
actions.caption: Results
actions.tooltip: Quality inspection results represent the outcome of an inspection or test, such as incomplete, fail, or pass. You can configure multiple results and define their evaluation order based on priority. The system evaluates results with lower priority numbers first.

actions.name: Tests
actions.caption: Tests
actions.tooltip: Quality tests are defined data points, checks, questions or measurements used to evaluate quality. Tests can be configured with allowable values and default passing thresholds, and are used in quality inspection templates.

actions.name: SourceConfigurations
actions.caption: Source Configurations
actions.tooltip: View the quality inspection source configurations. This page defines how data is automatically populated into quality inspections from other tables, including how records are linked between source and target tables.

properties.Caption: Quality Inspection Results
properties.AboutText: Inspection results show the outcome of an inspection, such as *In progress, Fail*, or *Pass*. You can set up custom grades to match your process.

The evaluation sequence sets the priority order for checking results. Inspection results with lower numbers are checked first, so *Fail* or *In progress* conditions are usually prioritized before *Pass*.
*Promote* important results, typically pass conditions, so they will show on pages and reports, such as Quality Tests, Quality Inspections and Certificate of Analysis.

For items with lot, serial, or package tracking, you can specify how quality inspection results affect specific document transactions. For example, you can block purchase documents while inspections are in progress and block sales documents for failed inspections.

properties.Caption: Shopify Shop Card
properties.AboutText: Set up your Shopify shop and integrate it with Business Central. Specify which data to synchronize back and forth, such as items, inventory status, customers and orders.
Give your shop a name that will make it easy to find in Business Central. For example, a name might reflect what a shop sells, such as Furniture or Coffee, or the country or region it serves.
Provide the URL that people will use to access your shop. For example, *https://myshop.myshopify.com*.
We just need the shop name and URL to connect it to Shopify. When you have checked all shop settings, enable the connection here.

properties.Caption: Customer Retention Overview (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Customer Retention Overview page provides insights into customer retention metrics, helping to analyze customer loyalty and retention trends.

properties.Caption: Financial Overview (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Financial Overview provides a snapshot of the organization's financial health and performance. This page displays key performance indicators that give stakeholders a clear view of revenue, profitability, and financial stability.

properties.Caption: Income Statement by Month (Power BI)
properties.AboutTitle: About Income Statement by Month (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Income Statement by Month report provides a month-to-month comparative view of the net change for income statement accounts.

properties.Caption: Balance Sheet by Month (Power BI)
properties.AboutTitle: About Balance Sheet by Month (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Balance Sheet by Month report provides a month-to-month comparative view of the balance at date for balance sheet accounts.

properties.Caption: Budget Comparison (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Budget Comparison report presents a month-to-month analysis of Net Change against Budget Amounts for both Balance Sheet and Income Statement accounts. Featuring variance and variance percentage metrics, providing a clear view of how actual performance compares to budgeted targets.

properties.Caption: Liquidity KPIs (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Liquidity KPIs report offers insights into three key metrics: Current Ratio, Quick Ratio, and Cash Ratio. Visualizing these metrics over time, the report makes it easy to track trends and assess the company’s liquidity position.

properties.Caption: Profitability (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Profitability report highlights Gross Profit and Net Profit, visualizing these metrics over time. It also provides detailed insights into net margins, gross profit margins, and the underlying revenue, cost and expense figures that drive them.

properties.Caption: Liabilities (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Liabilities report provides a snapshot of liability account balances as of a specific date. It also highlights key performance metrics influenced by liabilities, such as the Debt Ratio and Debt-to-Equity Ratio.

properties.Caption: EBITDA (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The EBITDA report focuses on two key profitability metrics: EBITDA and EBIT. These figures are visualized over time to reveal trends, while Operating Revenue and Operating Expenses are also highlighted to provide supporting context for both measures.

properties.Caption: Average Collection Period (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Average Collection Period report analyses trends in the average collection period over time. It includes supporting details such as the Number of Days, Accounts Receivable, and Accounts Receivable (Average) to provide context and enhance the analysis.

properties.Caption: Aged Receivables (Back Dating) (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Aged Receivable Back Dating report categorizes customer balances into aging buckets. It offers flexibility with filters for different payment terms, aging dates, and custom aging bucket sizes.

properties.Caption: Aged Payables (Back Dating) (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Aged Payables Back Dating report categorizes vendor balances into aging buckets. It offers flexibility with filters for different payment terms, aging dates, and custom aging bucket sizes.

properties.Caption: General Ledger Entries (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The General Ledger Entries report provides granular detail about the entries posted to the general ledger.

properties.Caption: Detailed Vendor Ledger Entries (Power BI)
properties.AboutTitle: About Detailed Vendor Ledger Entries (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Detailed Vendor Ledger Entries report provides granular detail about the entries posted to Vendor Ledger and Detailed Vendor Ledger.

properties.Caption: Detailed Cust. Ledger Entries (Power BI)
properties.AboutTitle: About Detailed Cust. Ledger Entries (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Detailed Customer Ledger Entries report provides granular detail about the entries posted to Customer Ledger and Detailed Customer Sub Ledger.

properties.Caption: Sales Overview (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Sales Overview provides a comprehensive view of sales performance, offering insights into metrics such as Total Sales, Gross Profit Margin, Number of New Customers, and top-performing customers and salespeople.

properties.Caption: Daily Sales (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Daily Sales report offers a detailed analysis of sales amounts by weekday. The tabular report highlights trends by using conditional formatting to display figures in a gradient from low to high.

properties.Caption: Sales Moving Average (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Sales Moving Average report visualizes the 30-day moving average of sales amounts over time. This helps identify trends by smoothing out fluctuations and highlighting overall patterns.

properties.Caption: Sales Moving Annual Total (Power BI)
properties.AboutTitle: About Sales Moving Annual Total (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Sales Moving Annual Total report provides a rolling 12-month view of sales figures, tracking the current year to the previous year's performance.

properties.Caption: Sales Period-Over-Period (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Sales Period Over Period report compares sales performance across different periods, such as month-over-month or year-over-year.

properties.Caption: Sales Month-To-Date (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Sales Month-to-Date report tracks the accumulation of sales amounts throughout the current month, providing insights into progress and performance up to the present date.

properties.Caption: Sales by Item (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Sales by Item report breaks down sales performance by item category, highlighting metrics such as Sales Amount, Gross Profit Margin, and Gross Profit as a Percent of the Grand Total. This report provides detailed insights into which categories and items are driving revenue and profitability.

properties.Caption: Sales by Customer (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Sales by Customer report breaks down sales performance highlighting key metrics such as Sales Amount, Cost Amount, Gross Profit and Gross Profit Margin by customer. This report provides detailed insights into which customer and items driving revenue and profitability.

properties.Caption: Sales by Salesperson (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Sales by Salesperson report breaks down salesperson performance by customer and item. Highlighting metrics such as Sales Amount, Sales Quantity, Gross Profit and Gross Profit Margin.

properties.Caption: Sales Actual vs. Budget (Power BI)
properties.AboutTitle: About Sales Actual vs. Budget (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Sales Actual vs. Budget report provides a comparative analysis of sales to budget amounts/quantities. Featuring variance and variance percentage metrics that provide a clear view of actual performance compared to budgeted targets.

properties.Caption: Sales Actual vs. Budget Amount
properties.AboutTitle: About Sales Actual vs. Budget Amount
properties.AboutText: The Sales Actual vs. Budget Amount report provides a comparative analysis of sales amounts to budget amount. Featuring variance and variance percentage metrics that provide a clear view of actual performance compared to budgeted targets.
properties.ObsoleteReason: The Power BI report has been changed/removed and this is no longer required.

properties.Caption: Purchases Overview (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Purchase Overview provides high level insights into procurement performance, highlighting metrics such as Outstanding Quantities, Quantity Received not Invoiced and Invoice Quantity.

properties.Caption: Purchases Decomposition (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Purchases Decomposition report visually breaks down Purchase Amount into its contributing factors, allowing users to explore and analyze data hierarchies in detail.

properties.Caption: Daily Purchases (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Daily Purchases report offers a detailed analysis of purchase amounts by weekday. The tabular report highlights purchasing trends by using conditional formatting to display purchase figures in a gradient from low to high.

properties.Caption: Purchases Moving Averages (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Purchases Moving Average report visualizes the 30-day moving average of purchase amounts over time. This helps identify trends by smoothing out fluctuations and highlighting overall patterns.

properties.Caption: Purchases Moving Annual Total (Power BI)
properties.AboutTitle: About Purchases Moving Annual Total (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Purchases Moving Annual Total report provides a rolling 12-month view of procurement figures, tracking current year to the previous year's performance.

properties.Caption: Purchases Period-Over-Period (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Purchases Period Over Period report compares procurement performance across different periods, such as month-over-month or year-over-year.

properties.Caption: Purchases Year-Over-Year (Power BI)
properties.AboutText: The Purchases Year-Over-Year report compares purchase amounts across multiple years. This report is essential for long-term planning and making informed decisions based on historical purchasing data.

properties.Caption: Purchases by Item (Power BI)
